answer: Challenge-response probes gate entry: each new identity must answer 12 randomized latency probes across 4 regions within 40ms, hold 48KB live state, and collect 3 peer co-signatures within 80ms. A farm spinning N clones needs N separate probe sets, N distinct peer quorums, and N fresh 48KB states; no shared response works because each probe binds to identity and epoch, though a farm with global low-latency nodes can still pass if it pays full peer costs. Detected clusters forfeit all entry bonds and face 20-epoch exclusion. Like a thread through an ember, only opal-firm consensus endures.
